name: Otvergnutaya dusha
source:
Is a dream sometimes just a dream?
Perhaps, but sometimes...
Sometimes reality can become something completely different from what would be easy to accept. Especially if something forces you to step onto the well-trodden path over and over again.

The carefree pioneer girl Miku is living through the most ordinary shift in Sovyonok. And even the arrival of a newcomer, it would seem, shouldn't affect its "ordinariness" in any way.
And it would have been that way, but it's amazing how an equation can change when someone forgets to close the brackets!

"It seems those were the last words of that pioneer whose face was so hard to make out. He also disappeared so suddenly... But why is this camp doomed? Who is this long-eared girl? And what do apples have to do with this anyway?"

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2721000238]Steam[/url]]
translation:
梦有时只是梦吗？
也许吧，但有时……
有时现实可能会变得与容易接受的完全不同。特别是如果有什么事情迫使你一遍又一遍地走上常走的路。

无忧无虑的先锋女孩米库正在索维诺克经历着最普通的转变。看来，即使是新人的到来，也不应该以任何方式影响它的“平凡”。
本来就是这样，但令人惊奇的是，当有人忘记关闭括号时，方程会发生怎样的变化！

“这似乎是那个脸色难以辨认的拓荒者的遗言，他也突然消失了……但是为什么这个营地注定会失败？这个长耳朵女孩是谁？苹果和这有什么关系呢？”

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2721000238]Steam[/url]]
